lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal janam sareer sabh hoaa jit raam naam paragaasiaa ||
lines.translation: Their lives and bodies become totally blessed and fruitful; the Lord's Name illumines them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhaj sadaa din raatee guramukh nij ghar vaasiaa ||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by continually vibrating upon the Lord, day and night, the Gurmukhs abide in the home of the inner self. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਰਧਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੂਜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin saradhaa raam naam lagee tinh doojai chit na laaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Those who place their faith in the Lord's Name, do not attach their consciousness to another.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: je dharatee sabh ka(n)chan kar deejai bin naavai avar na bhaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Even if the entire earth were to be transformed into gold, and given to them, without the Naam, they love nothing else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam man bhaaiaa param sukh paaiaa a(n)t chaladiaa naal sakhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is pleasing to their minds, and they obtain supreme peace; when they depart in the end, it shall go with them as their support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸੰਚੀ ਨਾ ਡੂਬੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam dhan poo(n)jee sa(n)chee naa doobai naa jaaee ||
lines.translation: I have gathered the capital, the wealth of the Lord's Name; it does not sink, and does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam is jug mahi tulahaa jamakaal neR na aavai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the only true support in this age; the Messenger of Death does not draw near it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh raam pachhaataa kar kirapaa aap milaavai ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs recognize the Lord; in His Mercy, He unites them with Himself. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੇ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamo raam naam sate sat guramukh jaaniaa raam ||
lines.translation: True, True is the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the Gurmukh knows the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevako gur sevaa laagaa jin man tan arap chaRaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: The Lord's servant is the one who commits himself to the Guru's service, and dedicates his mind and body as an offering to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan arapiaa bahut man saradhiaa gur sevak bhaai milaae ||
lines.translation: He dedicates his mind and body to Him, placing great faith in Him; the Guru lovingly unites His servant with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath jeeaa kaa daataa poore gur te paae ||
lines.translation: The Master of the meek, the Giver of souls, is obtained through the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo sikh sikh guroo hai eko gur upades chalaae ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Sikh, and the Sikh's Guru, are one and the same; both spread the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੮॥੨॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ma(n)t hiradai devai naanak milan subhaae ||8||2||9||
lines.translation: The Mantra of the Lord's Name is enshrined within the heart, O Nanak, and we merge with the Lord so easily. ||8||2||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har karataa dookh binaasan patit paavan har naam jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sevaa bhaaee param gat paaee har ootam har har kaam jeeu ||
lines.translation: One who lovingly serves the Lord, obtains the supreme status. Service to the Lord, Har, Har, is more exalted than anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ootam kaam japeeai har naam har japeeai asathir hovai ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the most exalted occupation; chanting the Name of the Lord, one becomes immortal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dovai dukh mete sahaje hee sukh sovai ||
lines.translation: The pains of both birth and death are eradicated, and one comes to sleep in peaceful ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har kirapaa dhaarahu thaakur har japeeai aatam raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: O Lord, O Lord and Master, shower Your Mercy upon me; within my mind, I chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har karataa dookh binaasan patit paavan har naam jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam padaarath kalijug ootam har japeeai satigur bhaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har paReeai guramukh har suneeai har japat sunat dukh jaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, read of the Lord; as Gurmukh, hear of the Lord. Chanting and listening to the Lord's Name, pain departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japiaa dukh binasiaa har naam param sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, pains are removed. Through the Name of the Lord, supreme peace is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur giaan baliaa ghat chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru illumines the heart; this Light dispels the darkness of spiritual ignorance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam tinee aaraadhiaa jin masatak dhur likh paai jeeu ||
lines.translation: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, Har, Har, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har naam padaarath kalijug ootam har japeeai satigur bhaai jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har man bhaaiaa param sukh paaiaa har laahaa pad nirabaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har preet lagaaee har naam sakhaaee bhram chookaa aavan jaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: He embraces love for the Lord, and the Lord's Name becomes his companion. His doubts, and his comings and goings are ended.
